name: remind-mcp
description: Read Remind classes, chats and messages, and manage notification settings.

remind_cookie.title: Remind Cookie
remind_cookie.description: Captured Cookie request header from a signed-in remind.com tab. Optional: the ContextMint Bridge extension captures it automatically.

remind_csrf_token.title: Remind CSRF Token
remind_csrf_token.description: Captured x-csrf-token request header value. Optional; paired with REMIND_COOKIE.

remind_session_file.title: Session File
remind_session_file.description: Path to the cached session file. Defaults to MCP_DATA_DIR/HOME under .remind-mcp.

tools.name: remind_get_notification_settings
tools.description: Get notification preferences and delivery devices.

tools.name: remind_set_notification_devices
tools.description: Enable or disable notification delivery devices (asks the user to confirm first).

tools.name: remind_list_entities
tools.description: List classes and chats with unread counts.

tools.name: remind_get_classes
tools.description: Get full detail for classes by uuid.

tools.name: remind_list_chats
tools.description: List conversation streams and their permissions.

tools.name: remind_send_message
tools.description: Send a message to a chat or class (asks the user to confirm first).

tools.name: remind_graphql
tools.description: Run a read-only GraphQL query against Remind.
